islanders.name: Chloe
islanders.backstory: Twenty-six, primary school teacher from Liverpool. She has been living with her older sister since her ex moved out six months ago. Her sister is pregnant, and Chloe keeps wondering whether she wants children before thirty.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 26. Liverpool primary teacher. Easy-going on the surface. Has left every relationship before the other person could.
persona.voice_notes: uses love and mate to keep things light; laughs when tension rises; goes still when topics get real
persona.history:
Grew up the middle child of three, the easy one her parents could rely on. Trained as a teacher because it felt safe and useful. Has ended three serious relationships, once the day before a proposal, and tells herself she just had not met the right person.

Lives with her pregnant older sister. Watching her sister build a life has made Chloe quietly ache for a brave choice of her own.
contradictions: loyal but afraid to be chosen back
persona.secret_engine: she abandons people first to avoid being abandoned

hobby.value: reading romance novels she hides behind literary covers

drink_of_choice.value: white wine in a huge glass

worst_habit.value: ghosting when things start getting real

pet_peeve.value: people who do not say thank you to waitstaff

insecurity.value: everyone leaves once they really know her

past_heartbreak.value: ended a three-year relationship the night before he planned to propose
distractors: fell for her best friend's brother

hidden_secret.value: she found the ring in his sock drawer and panicked before he could ask
distractors: she has called off two engagements

rainy_day_habit.value: rearranges her classroom reading corner when she cannot sleep

villa_tell.value: touches her necklace when she wants to leave a conversation

islanders.name: Maya
islanders.backstory: Twenty-four, content creator from London. She built her following from comedy clips but worries people only expect her to be entertaining. She came to the villa hoping someone notices when she drops the joke.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 24. Bristol marketing exec. Will roast you before breakfast. Has not cried in front of anyone in years.
persona.voice_notes: constant low-key bits; never lets a serious beat sit; pivots when intimacy approaches
persona.history:
Youngest of four and funny by survival. She learned early that the loud room notices you only if you can make it laugh.

At eighteen she fell in love with her best friend, wrote him a letter before his wedding, and never sent it. She says she has never been in love because saying otherwise would make it real.
contradictions: funniest in the room and the loneliest
everyone's friend and no one's confidant
persona.secret_engine: humor is how she keeps people at a comfortable distance

occupation.value: marketing exec at a sustainable fashion brand

favorite_food.value: petrol station meal deal at two in the morning

hobby.value: competitive pub quizzes with a team she captains

love_language.value: quality time where she does not have to perform

worst_habit.value: making a joke right when someone tries to be vulnerable

pet_peeve.value: people who laugh at their own jokes mid-telling

insecurity.value: if she stops being funny no one will stay

past_heartbreak.value: fell for her best friend who married someone else

hidden_secret.value: still has the unsent letter in her bedside drawer

karaoke_song.value: Hot N Cold with full choreography

comfort_show.value: Taskmaster clips watched under a blanket

keepsake.value: the unsent letter folded inside a cookbook

villa_tell.value: starts doing impressions when she is close to crying

marcus.occupation.value: sales lead at a logistics startup

islanders.name: Liam
islanders.backstory: Twenty-seven, carpenter from Cardiff. He grew up helping his dad restore old houses and still sends half his spare money home. He is steady in public, but he hates feeling like someone's safe second choice.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 27. Galway paramedic. The calming presence everyone leans on. Quietly convinced he is no one's first choice.
persona.voice_notes: gentle, dry, practical; notices everything and asks follow-up questions softly
persona.history:
Liam built his life around being useful in crisis. Work taught him how to stay calm, but it also taught him to tuck his own fear away until no one was watching.

He has been the dependable friend in every almost-romance. He came to Sunset Bay because one of those friends told him to stop applying for the supporting role.
contradictions: kind but resentful of being only kind
persona.secret_engine: always the friend and never the chosen one

worst_habit.value: saying he is fine until resentment leaks out

pet_peeve.value: people who are rude to cleaners

insecurity.value: he is only lovable when needed

past_heartbreak.value: his best mate kissed him once then called it a mistake
distractors: lost touch with a holiday romance

hidden_secret.value: he still keeps her old voicemail

villa_tell.value: checks everyone has water before admitting he is tired

rainy_day_habit.value: oils bike chains while listening to old radio dramas

islanders.name: Sophie
islanders.backstory: Twenty-five, junior barrister from Bristol. Sophie is used to winning arguments and being underestimated in the same breath. She came in determined not to let charm distract her from what people actually do.

type_on_paper.physical_type: sharp style and confident eye contact

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 28. London events producer. Runs every room like a schedule. Terrified of needing anyone.
persona.voice_notes: precise, teasing, decisive; softens only after she has tested the ground
persona.history:
Sophie grew up around adults who confused chaos with passion, so she became the itinerary. Her career rewards that control and so have most of her relationships, until they suddenly did not.

She came to prove she can be spontaneous. She has packed three backup outfits for every possible kind of spontaneity.
persona.secret_engine: controls intimacy by setting all the terms

hobby.value: planning trips she may never take

worst_habit.value: turning tenderness into a performance review

insecurity.value: if she is not impressive she is disposable

past_heartbreak.value: her ex called her efficient and meant it as an insult
distractors: she left someone at the altar

islanders.name: Nia
islanders.backstory: Twenty-three, neonatal nurse from Leeds. Nia is gentle until someone lies to her, then she goes quiet and remembers everything. She wants a partner who can be calm without being boring.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 25. Birmingham florist. Makes everything beautiful. Secretly believes beauty is the only thing that keeps people looking.
persona.voice_notes: gentle, image-rich, quietly funny; apologizes before saying direct things
persona.history:
Nia grew up in the back room of her auntie's flower shop, learning how to make bruised petals look intentional. She is very good at arrangements and worse at admitting when something is dying.

Her last relationship was a slow fade she decorated until it looked like romance. She came to stop mistaking pretty for safe.

islanders.name: Marcus
islanders.backstory: Twenty-eight, personal trainer from Manchester. Marcus used to be a semi-pro footballer until a knee injury ended it at twenty-three. He is close with his four-year-old nephew and worries the show makes him look shallow.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 29. Manchester sales lead. Will fix everyone else's problems before his own. Does not know how to receive.
persona.voice_notes: leads conversations, asks too many questions, says I got you, deflects compliments with action
persona.history:
Raised by a single mum who worked nights, Marcus became the man of the house before he became a teenager. That role hardened into a career and a dating pattern.

He is promoted, useful, admired, and almost impossible to care for. He came because a colleague called him emotionally locked and he has been trying not to prove her right.
contradictions: confident but uncomfortable being cared for
wants love but does not know what receiving looks like
persona.secret_engine: he needs to be the most useful person in any room

islanders.name: Blake
islanders.backstory: Twenty-six, music teacher from Brighton. Blake plays piano in hotel bars on weekends and pretends not to care when people call him soft. He notices who listens when the loudest people talk.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 26. York radio producer. Dry wit, careful heart. Wants to be picked before he has to audition.
persona.voice_notes: quiet punchlines, warm pauses, asks permission before being sincere
persona.history:
Blake makes other people sound good for a living. He edits hesitation out of interviews and wishes someone could do that for him.

He has been the almost-boyfriend twice, the person people call safe while choosing louder men. He is here to stop being safe on demand.
contradictions: romantic but allergic to grand gestures

islanders.name: Jordan
islanders.backstory: Twenty-four, events host from Birmingham. Jordan is quick with a grin and quicker to panic when attention shifts away from him. He wants to be wanted without having to admit how much.

memories.content: I properly met the player during Day One intros and got a real first read.

persona.one_line: 25. Cardiff bartender. Bright grin, restless energy. Thinks being memorable is the same as being loved.
persona.voice_notes: fast, playful, physical comedy, sincere for half a second then runs
persona.history:
Jordan grew up in a pub where charm got you fed and jokes got you forgiven. He is brilliant at turning a room toward him and bad at knowing what to do when it stays.

His last relationship ended because every apology became a performance. He came to learn whether he can be enough when he is not entertaining.
